notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal non-lethal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
description:
Deal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Siegehorn Ceratops triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Repeat from step 2.
